title: Sunday · the mudflats, low tide
logline: The first mudflats Sunday. The composition the strip will use in 2014 and 2027, found here by accident: the flats, the far chimney, the tide line, a man and a dog small.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the mudflats at low tide from the bluff, the channels silver, the cannery's chimney across the bay, a man and a dog far out, small.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, tidal mudflats at low tide seen from a bluff with silver channels, a distant chimney across the bay, and a man and a small dog far out on the mud, no words
image.notes: This composition returns in 'The Carry' (2014) and the final page (2027). Draw it exactly.
